finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Just don’t go and do something dumb on Earth,” Scarlett sighed, fully aware that fighting Draskil likely wouldn’t end well for her if it came down to it. While she was many levels higher than him, he was still considered a top-tier genius by the standards of the multiverse and someone far superior to herself. Not that she was too worried, as Earth had things that were far more threatening than she.
